browser.scope: Synthetic task source, event transport and note-link host; real DOM pointer/drag interactions.

checks: fixture tasks indexed from native vault
native view has no self-triggering refresh loop
no new captured native JavaScript errors
obsidian.scope: Native vault, metadata and DOM. Apple events are synthetic; no permission request or real calendar read/write.
obsidian.tasksPlugin: Tasks was absent in the native vault. Separately, the actual Tasks 8.5.0 release toggle API and local bridge passed 19 isolated VM checks.
obsidian.cleanup: Unique fixtures deleted, native workspace restored, prior undo and journal-link component restored.

tasksUpstream.scope: Actual official release API in isolated VM, native UI classes stubbed; no Tasks installation or user vault access.

limits: Native vault did not have Tasks installed; its plugin startup/UI and real simultaneous editing with Tasks were not tested.
Single completed-line output is ambiguous between global-filter fallback and an ended recurrence; both preserve source and require completion in the original note.
Custom checkbox statuses and on-completion deletion are not supported by this bridge.
Real Apple Calendar authorization, read/write round trips and cloud synchronization were not tested.
Short regression runs are not evidence of long-term memory stability.
